correctness.rationale: PASS conditional on the explicitly stated published Yi–Gill–Bu classification, which was read in its primary full text and is NOT independently reproved here. The permitted primitive x,y pairs occupy eight mod-4 classes, each of density area/(2 pi²) after Möbius inversion; area(T)=1/4 gives H²/pi² with O(H log H). Their m formula scales to eight positive piecewise-linear forms L; exact rational clipping areas sum to 16/3 and max u+2v=4. Thus for z>=1/2, c=(8z)^-1 gives area tail (1/2)*c²*(16/3)=1/(24z²), and the layer-cake moment threshold s<2. The finite exceptional families contribute only O(H); small rational polygon/census tests corroborate, never replace, the argument.
